tldr: French police have suspended the use of stun grenades in response to student protests across France after a demonstrator lost a hand.
Canada has indefinitely suspended plans to expand assisted dying to include individuals with mental illness.
Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai were awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed higher on October 6, with stocks making a record high, although some trading indicated skepticism among investors.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield eased from its 24-year high on October 6 following a solid bond auction, which helped alleviate demand concerns.

vix.why: The articles do not provide a specific reason for the VIX move.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased over the past week, reaching its highest level in three years, as refinance demand halved and rising borrowing costs impacted the housing market. This movement aligns with the overall trend of higher 10-year Treasury yields in recent days.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This document contains proposed regulations regarding employer contributions to Trump accounts and nondiscrimination rules for dependent care assistance programs.
policy_week.effect: Employer contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance and nondiscrimination rules.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations provide general requirements for Trump accounts, their establishment, and qualified general contributions.
policy_week.effect: You would be affected by new requirements for establishing Trump accounts and making qualified contributions to them.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

tech.summary: Microsoft is enhancing its Copilot AI system, granting it access to local files on PCs and the ability to take actions across the Windows operating system as part of a new "Hybrid Intelligence" initiative.
Microsoft has announced that its Nvidia RTX Spark-equipped Surface Laptop Ultra will launch on October 16th, with pricing starting at $2,599 for the base configuration.
A new study indicates that AI bots like Claude and ChatGPT may offer different shopping prices based on perceived wealth.

world.summary: Student protests continue across France and Belgium over education costs, with French police suspending the use of stun grenades after a demonstrator lost a hand and over 100 students arrested in Belgium.

Ukraine accused Russia of deliberately bombing an apartment block in Pryluky, killing nine people, which Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as a "macabre gift" for Vladimir Putin's birthday.
Canada has indefinitely paused its plans to expand assisted dying eligibility to include individuals with mental illness, which was previously slated to take effect in March 2027.
A German court ordered the pre-trial detention of August Hanning, Germany's former top spy, a day after his arrest on suspicion of treason and espionage for a foreign state.

us.summary: Researchers have uncovered the graves of more than 1,000 children buried next to juvenile detention facilities across 29 states, including 230 Black boys at one Maryland site.
President Trump approved execution by firing squad for the former Army psychiatrist who killed 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009.
A former senior CIA official pleaded guilty to abusing his position to steal hundreds of gold bars and acquire Florida real estate worth over $40 million.

science.summary: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai were awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.
The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Francis Halzen for his work on building a neutrino detector under Antarctica to study high-energy neutrinos from space.
